name: Rain Be Gone Ritual
summary: Lets survival players stop rain by performing a small multi-block ritual: cauldrons placed around a log, then the log is set alight.

mechanics.title: Stopping the rain ritual
mechanics.description: Place 4 to 8 cauldrons (empty or filled) around a log in one of the supported layouts, then ignite the log with flint and steel. A harmless explosion effect plays, the cauldrons fill with water and the rain stops.

getting_started: Surround a log with at least four cauldrons and light the log with flint and steel.
editor_notes: Exact accepted cauldron layouts are shown only in images on the mod page; text states min 4, max 8 cauldrons around the log. Requires Collective. Serilum mod.
